end.parentNote: Asha practised factorising by finding two numbers whose product is q and sum is p, then forming brackets. Arjun correctly identified 2 and 3 for product 6 and sum 5, and expanded  (x + 5)(x - 3) into x² + 2x - 15. Arjun continued to copy coefficients into brackets for x² + 5x + 6; this mix-up was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, practise checking a bracket answer by expanding it and comparing the middle and constant terms.
